'''"A"''' (Japanese: '''Aさん''' ''Ms. A'') is a recurring character in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}. Her real name is unknown.

==History==
==={{MangaArc|Red, Green & Blue}}===
A first appeared in ''[[PS010|Danger: High Voltorb]]''. She was seen on a newspaper that {{adv|Red}} was shown to by the [[Pokémon Fan Club Chairman]]. She had received a shock when taking a bath with her {{p|Tentacool}}.

==={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}===
In ''[[PS179|The Last Battle XIII]]'', she was seen taking another bath with her Tentacool. A was one of the people who heard a message from the Pokémon Fan Club Chairman asking for people to send their Pokémon to help battle {{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Ho-Oh and Lugia}}.

==={{MangaArc|Emerald}}===
In ''[[PS337|Epilogue]]'', A and her Tentacool were among the many people who went to the {{gdis|Battle Frontier|III}} as a result of [[Scott]] wishing on {{adv|Jirachi}}.

==Trivia==
* In the English versions of ''[[PS010|Danger: High Voltorb]]'' by [[Chuang Yi]] and [[VIZ]], there is a quote by A that was not found in the Japanese version: "That's the last bath I'll take with my {{p|Tentacool}}!" This contradicts her later appearance in ''[[PS179|The Last Battle XIII]]'', where she is seen bathing with her Tentacool again.
